reason: Provides a Node.js bridge that adapts Streamable HTTP MCP to stdio clients and exposes a connected Chrome MCP service for browser automation, interaction, extraction, and browser data operations.

summaries.zh: 通过 Node.js 将 Streamable HTTP MCP 服务桥接为 stdio 接口，供 AI 客户端调用 Chrome 浏览器自动化工具。
summaries.en: A Node.js bridge that exposes Streamable HTTP MCP browser automation services to AI clients through a stdio interface.

capabilities: Bridges Streamable HTTP MCP services to stdio MCP clients
Maintains and persists MCP session identifiers in temporary files
Invokes configured Chrome browser automation tools

Can navigate pages, interact with elements, extract page data, capture screenshots, monitor network requests, execute page JavaScript, and access browser history, bookmarks, and cookies through the connected MCP service
